body: The latest directly verified NQ quote available to this assessment is delayed rather than live. lookbackSummary: Over the prior 24 clock-hours, ChatGPT history moved from low Tail during Sunday evening into event/whipsaw WATCH and brief elevated readings as geopolitical and oil stress intensified.
